title: Images section (.bzXtMb) mis-centers on knowledge-panel pages; zoom change breaks centering
description:
Reported by user 2026-09-27 (Dev Edition FF156, add-on 1.0.5 unsigned build, wide window).

REPRO: search 'banana' -> knowledge-panel page with photos. The images section (.bzXtMb) does not center correctly. Changing browser zoom 'breaks' the centering (scope: unclear if all targets or this row only).

SUSPECTS (from content.js review): (a) zone rebalance shifts outer tracks of #rcnt while 1/-1 rows stay full-bleed — .bzXtMb content may inherit zone position in a way that reads off-center; (b) zoom fires resize -> caches: colWidth captured ONCE (never invalidated), base.iw tolerance 2px, verifyCount reset — a stale/partial recalculation mid-relayout could compound. Next: live probe (Xvfb + real Firefox + marionette) on banana en+pt at 2560, geometry of column/panel/.bzXtMb before/after, then zoom matrix 80/100/110/125/150.

title: AI overview: 'show more / ask anything' control not centered (wide screens)
description:
Reported by user 2026-09-27. When an AI overview shows, the 'show more button / ask anything' control is not centered.

DOM path given: body#gsr.srp > #main.n48JGd > #cnt.e9EfHf > #rcnt.NbTBrb.YNk70c.EjQTId.uW3HW.GyAeWb > div.bzXtMb.M8OgIe.dRpWwb > div > div > div#Odp5De > div.YNk70c.EjQTId > div.Kevs9.SLPe5b > div > div#eKIzJc.Wm5I1e.SePcAf (or after).

NOTES: the AI overview sits in a .bzXtMb full-bleed row (same row class as the banana media strip fixed in 1.0.6), with a nested YNk70c.EjQTId grid + Kevs9 content; suspect the SAME ghost-grid misalignment applies here — our 1.0.6 ghost fix only runs in the knowledge-panel mode (#rhs visible); if this layout is panel-less (or its ghost grid differs from the #rcnt baseline template) it stays left. Repro attempt: find an AI-overview render live (candidates: informational queries; possibly affects both en and pt on All tab).
